question: How much did Sacramento public-supply use change from 2017 to 2018?
expected_sql: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2018 THEN annual_avg_use_mgd END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN annual_avg_use_mgd END) AS change_mgd FROM water_huc4_annual_category WHERE watershed = 'Sacramento' AND category = 'public_supply' AND year IN (2017, 2018)
agent_answer: Sacramento public-supply use decreased by 4.457158683850082 MGD, a −0.9548554485354214% change from 2017 to 2018.
agent_sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_avg_use_mgd FROM water_huc4_annual_category WHERE watershed='Sacramento' AND category='public_supply' AND year=2018)
  -
  (SELECT annual_avg_use_mgd FROM water_huc4_annual_category WHERE watershed='Sacramento' AND category='public_supply' AND year=2017)
  AS absolute_change_mgd,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT annual_avg_use_mgd FROM water_huc4_annual_category WHERE watershed='Sacramento' AND category='public_supply' AND year=2017) IS NULL
      OR (SELECT annual_avg_use_mgd FROM water_huc4_annual_category WHERE watershed='Sacramento' AND category='public_supply' AND year=2017)=0
    THEN NULL
    ELSE
      ((SELECT annual_avg_use_mgd FROM water_huc4_annual_category WHERE watershed='Sacramento' AND category='public_supply' AND year=2018)
       -
       (SELECT annual_avg_use_mgd FROM water_huc4_annual_category WHERE watershed='Sacramento' AND category='public_supply' AND year=2017)
      ) / (SELECT annual_avg_use_mgd FROM water_huc4_annual_category WHERE watershed='Sacramento' AND category='public_supply' AND year=2017) * 100
  END AS percent_change;
